checks.name: Physical input fence is registered on iframe window capture before document touch interception
A complete quick tap between HUD polls immediately suspends native ALL intent and keeps it fenced through release settling
Pending native click acknowledgement extends suspension beyond the250ms physical release fence
Multiple pointers remain fenced until every physical pointer is released or cancelled
Adapter-forwarded mouse events cannot create or release physical touch fences
Blur, mission reset, battle end and pagehide clear stale physical IDs without leaving native ALL enabled on exit

scope: Actual campaign controller event/intent VM checks. Native idempotent-selection behavior and world orders are verified by native checks and the delivery emulator journey.
